content.text:
The tests pass: all 3 of 3, including the 15% discount test.

The bug was in `cartTotal` in `src/cart.js`. It used `Math.floor` on the discount, so a 157.5 discount became 157 instead of 158. I changed it to `Math.round`, which rounds half up for the non-negative amounts here. I didn't touch `lineTotal`, the no-discount path, the tests or the dependencies.
